segments.name: Drones
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells fixed-wing uncrewed aerial systems for military, defense, public safety, agriculture, surveying and utilities.
segments.evidence: In 2025, the Company re-focused on its two primary product lines – Uncrewed Aircraft Systems and Multispectral Sensors.

segments.name: Sensors
segments.description: Develops and distributes advanced thermal and multispectral drone sensors for agriculture, plant research, land management and forestry.
segments.evidence: In early 2022, AgEagle completed development and brought to market the Altum-PT™ and RedEdge-P™ — next generation thermal and multispectral sensors which offer critical advancements on MicaSense's legacy sensor products to customers primarily in agriculture, plant research, land management and forestry management.

revenueModel.text: Customers purchase drones, sensors and software; revenue from drones and sensors is reported by product line.
